body:
Data: `gate-logs/release-20261114-185541/` (v0.20.0 cut, 86.6 min, 12 steps, serial). Times are the `finished in` value of one test binary. Cargo runs the binaries one after the other, and the tests inside a binary on 6 threads.

## Where the time goes

- Step 08 (app, debug): 31 min. Build 4 min. The binary times add up to 23 min.
- Step 12 (app heavy, release): 28 min. Build 6.6 min. The binary times add up to 18 min. The run stopped early in `shared_face_bodies` (0.13 s). The 28 min test of that binary did not run. A green run takes about 115 min.
- Step 11 (motion heavy, release): 7 min. Step 07 (motion, debug): 8 min. Step 06 (sim): 5 min.
- Steps 09 (ui) and 10 (clippy): 2 min each. Steps 02 (kernel): 3 min. All other steps: 1 min or less.

## Table B: slowest test binaries

| Step | Binary | Seconds | Mode | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 12 | `shared_face_bodies` (`the_sample_as_imported_still_generates_the_3d_finish`) | about 1680 (maintainer figure) | release | 3D Finish over a 118 mm Z span, one test |
| 12 | `rotary_field_parity` (`every_rotary_kind_reads_the_radial_law_and_its_cost_is_measured`) | 768 | release | one test: 3 `parity()` calls and 3 `eye_cost()` calls in series, about 90000 sub-chords each |
| 08 | `whole_model_pocket` | 125 | debug | 5 tests, each a full HSM plan, 17 samples per feed move |
| 11 | `rotary_adaptive` | 111 | release | 3 ignored tests, each 3 HSM plans |
| 08 | `lathe_field_sim` | 104 | debug | 6 tests, voxel parity loops over the field |
| 11 | `camcraft-motion` lib unit tests | 93 | release | 5 ignored perturbation tests (`adaptive::budget::twins`) |
| 11 | `adaptive_hsm` | 92 | release | HSM plans on a big fixture |
| 02 | `step_agreement` (`step_files_agree_or_refuse_by_name`) | 90 | debug | one test, serial loop over 15 STEP files, 3 readers per file |
| 08 | `keep_law` | 76 | debug | 8 tests, 5 of them over 60 s: full plan plus verify |
| 08 | `level_links` | 74 | debug | 7 tests, a full contour per level-link choice |
| 08 | `operations` | 71 | debug | 119 tests, 6 threads |
| 12 | `adaptive_pinch` | 68 | release | one test, two stocks, HSM plan on the user's part |
| 08 | `adaptive_pinch` (non-ignored test) | 59 | debug | the same fixture, the other test |
| 08 | `pocket_overhead` | 58 | debug | 2 tests, big fixture |
| 11 | `finish3d` | 56 | release | 33 ignored tests |
| 12 | `lathe_workholding_kinds` | 52 | release | one test, 5 kinds in series |
| 07 | `camcraft-motion` lib unit tests | 52 | debug | 341 tests |
| 08 | `roughing2d` | 51 | debug | 7 tests |
| 07 | `pivot5d` | 49 | debug | 7 tests, in `SLOW_BINARIES` |
| 12 | `carried_engine_agreement` | 44 | release | one test, both stock engines |
| 07 | `flow` | 43 | debug | 13 tests, in `SLOW_BINARIES` |
| 07 | `finish3d` | 42 | debug | 55 tests, in `SLOW_BINARIES` |
| 02 | `solidcraft_import` | 40 | debug | 7 tests, STEP kernel |
| 07 | `trochoid_slot` | 39 | debug | 11 tests |
| 08 | `climb_direction` | 38 | debug | 2 tests, big fixture |

The log shows no time for each single test. A binary with one test is a single-test time.

## Table C: proposals, ranked by minutes saved

| # | Proposal | Saves | Risk |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Split `the_sample_as_imported_still_generates_the_3d_finish`: the 118 mm Z span is one job. Generate the levels in separate tests, or use a coarser fixture slice (a 20 mm band of the same sample). | up to 25 min | Keep a full-span run at the cut only if the maintainer wants it. Count `#[test]` before and after. |
| 2 | Split `every_rotary_kind_reads_the_radial_law_and_its_cost_is_measured` into 6 tests: `parity(Kind::X)` and `eye_cost(Kind::X)` for each kind. Each is an independent test, and libtest runs them on 6 threads. | about 8 min | Memory: 3 large fields at the same time. |
| 3 | Run the 12 app heavy binaries and the motion heavy binaries as parallel lanes after one `--release --no-run` build (issue 1714 steps). Wall time becomes the slowest binary: about 13 min plus the finish3d test, not 25 min. | about 10 min | None, if the binaries do not share files. |
| 4 | Run debug lanes and release lanes at the same time. They use `target/debug` and `target/release`. Only the cargo build lock is shared, so build first and run the built binaries directly. | about 30 min | Disk and memory. 4 lanes with `-j 6` each need 4x the CPU. |
| 5 | Run the per-crate debug steps 02 to 07 as parallel lanes after one `--no-run` build. Only app (step 08) and motion (step 07) are long. | about 8 min | None. |
| 6 | Split `step_files_agree_or_refuse_by_name` into one test for each of the 15 STEP files (a macro or a generated list). The pinned `ROWS` table stays. | about 60 s of 90 s | The "fixture has no row" check must stay as its own test. |
| 7 | Split the multi-test binaries `whole_model_pocket`, `keep_law`, `level_links`, `lathe_field_sim` into smaller binaries of 1 to 3 tests, or run them as separate `--test` lanes. Today the binaries run serially, and a binary with 5 tests of 60 s on 6 threads does not fill the CPU. | about 6 min in step 08 | Memory per test. |
| 8 | Lighter fixture for `whole_model_pocket`, `pocket_overhead`, `climb_direction`, `adaptive_pinch` (debug test). Use a smaller block and a coarser grid where the law does not depend on size. | about 4 min | Do not lose the gouge check. Safety floor: effort:high. |
| 9 | Remove repeated builds: the release tier builds deps three times (debug 4 min in step 08, release 6.6 min in step 12, clippy 1 min). A shared `cargo test --no-run` per profile, run once, saves the rebuilds in steps 09 and 11. | about 3 min | None. |
| 10 | Move `motion:finish3d`, `pivot5d`, `flow` out of the serial debug run into their own lane. | about 2 min (in a parallel plan) | None. |

Redundancy: no suite runs twice. The `--ignored` lanes run only ignored tests. Only the build work is repeated (proposal 9).

Estimate for a 4-lane gate on one machine: lane 1 = debug build + steps 01 to 07 (about 12 min); lane 2 = debug app (about 25 min, 15 min after proposal 7); lane 3 = release build + motion heavy + app heavy without the long test (about 20 min); lane 4 = the long finish test, split (about 8 min); ui and clippy after (4 min). Wall time is about 25 to 30 min, against 86.6 min now (115 min with the long test). This needs enough cores and RAM.

Rules for the parallel plan:
- The time-limit tests (30 s and 90 s watchdogs) can fail under load. Run them in a lane alone, or give them a limit that scales with load.
- The ui suites open windows. Keep them in one serial lane.
- The `#[test]` count before and after each split must match.
The maintainer set this issue to `P1` (2026-11-14, in chat: "that triaged testing issues - needs to get moved up to a P1"). The priority was `P4`.
